paper_id: Duan et al. - 2018 - Tagspin High Accuracy Spatial Calibration of RFID Antennas via Spinning Tags
title: Tagspin: High Accuracy Spatial Calibration of RFID Antennas via Spinning Tags
motivation: RFID reader calibration manual且耗时(20-30分钟),费力且不准确
problem_framing: 用低成本设施标签定位reader天线,用旋转标签模拟圆形天线阵列
key_insight: 标签相位与朝向存在规律性关联,校准后可将精度提升3.7倍
method_signature: 旋转标签产生虚拟天线阵列,SAR计算角度谱,高斯加权功率剖面定位
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 天线方向角附近存在较大连续高峰区域,易受噪声干扰
evidence_for_taste: phase measurements are resistant against tag orientations
the power profile has a peak at the angle direction
our idea and method of accounting for tag orientation
the localization accuracy is impaired to a certain degree
the accuracy can be further improved
thinking_moves: 从经典AoA方法推导SAR功率谱,指出传统方法不抗噪
通过控制变量实验发现相位与朝向的隐性关联
将reader定位问题反向frame为tag旋转问题
从理论公式推导发现diversity不影响功率谱峰值位置
用傅里叶级数拟合相位-朝向关系量化误差
